title: Moroni’s warning
summary: Moroni says he wrote the commanded words from memory and told the reader about the things he sealed up. He forbids touching them to translate unless it later becomes wisdom in God.

explicit_facts.text: Moroni says he wrote the words commanded him according to his memory.
Moroni says he told the reader about the things he sealed up.
Moroni forbids touching those things to translate them, except when it later becomes wisdom in God.

unspecified_visual_details: Whether the sealed things are visible.

narration.text: And now I, Moroni, have written the words which were commanded me, according to my memory;
therefore touch them not in order that ye may translate;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: Moroni’s writing is described as completed, not as an action occurring during this warning.
prohibited_inventions: Do not show Moroni writing as a present action.
Do not depict anyone touching or translating the sealed things.
Do not invent a specific setting, writing materials, or an appearance for Moroni.

title: Moroni’s words concerning the plates and three witnesses
summary: Moroni says the addressee may show the plates to those who assist in bringing forth the work. He says three will be shown the plates by the power of God, and their testimony will establish these things.

explicit_facts.text: Moroni says the addressee may be privileged to show the plates to those who assist in bringing forth the work.
Moroni says the plates will be shown to three by the power of God, and they will know these things are true.
Moroni says the testimony of three will establish these things.
Moroni says the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost bear record, and that this will stand as a testimony against the world at the last day.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Moroni can be represented as the narrator, but the verses do not place the three witnesses before him.
unspecified_visual_details: The identities and appearances of the three witnesses
How the plates will be shown

narration.text: And behold, ye may be privileged that ye may show the plates unto those who shall assist to bring forth this work;
And unto three shall they be shown by the power of God; wherefore they shall know of a surety that these things are true.
And in the mouth of three witnesses shall these things be established;

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The showing of the plates is foretold, not narrated as occurring in this scene.
The Father, Son, and Holy Ghost are said to bear record; no visible appearance is described.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the future showing of the plates as a present event.
Do not invent identities for the three witnesses or a visible appearance of divine figures.

title: An invitation to repent
summary: Moroni says that those who repent and come to the Father in the name of Jesus will be received into the kingdom of God.

explicit_facts.text: Those who repent and come to the Father in the name of Jesus will be received into the kingdom of God.

reasonable_visual_inferences: Moroni may be represented as continuing his address; no listener or setting is specified.
unspecified_visual_details: Moroni’s appearance, setting, and any depiction of the kingdom of God.

narration.text: if it so be that they repent and come unto the Father in the name of Jesus
they shall be received into the kingdom of God

doctrinal_or_story_notes: This is a conditional teaching, not a narrated conversion or visible entrance into the kingdom.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict people repenting or entering the kingdom as a present event.

title: Moroni’s final appeal
summary: Moroni invites the reader to judge whether he has authority, saying that the reader will know he has authority when they see him and that they will stand before God at the last day. He concludes, “Amen.”

explicit_facts.text: Moroni tells the reader to judge whether he has authority and says they will know he has authority when they see him.
Moroni says he and the reader will stand before God at the last day, then concludes “Amen.”

reasonable_visual_inferences: Moroni may be shown addressing the reader; the future meeting before God is not depicted as occurring now.
unspecified_visual_details: Moroni’s appearance and setting; the circumstances of the future meeting.

narration.text: judge ye; for ye shall know that I have authority when ye shall see me

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The future meeting is reported in Moroni’s address, not a present-tense scene.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict the future appearance before God as happening in this scene.
Do not invent an appearance of God.
